catalog.label: HH / HL
catalog.rule: Confirmed higher highs or higher lows; bullish structure requires both. Pivots require two bars on each side.

catalog.label: LH / LL
catalog.rule: Confirmed lower highs or lower lows; bearish structure requires both.

catalog.label: Sideways range
catalog.rule: Last 10 bars span at most 3 × prior ATR(14), with net movement below 1 ATR.

catalog.label: Support
catalog.rule: Two confirmed swing lows within the level tolerance form a reaction zone.

catalog.label: Resistance
catalog.rule: Two confirmed swing highs within the level tolerance form a reaction zone.

catalog.label: Support / resistance flip
catalog.rule: A closed break of a known level followed by a later retest holding its new side, within 8 bars.

catalog.label: Previous day high
catalog.rule: High of the previous available daily candle; its actual session date is shown.

catalog.label: Previous day low
catalog.rule: Low of the previous available daily candle; its actual session date is shown.

catalog.label: Day high / low
catalog.rule: Running extrema of completed session bars; no final-day level is drawn over earlier bars.

catalog.label: Equal highs / lows
catalog.rule: Two confirmed same-side pivots within tolerance; confirmed two bars after the second pivot.

catalog.label: Liquidity sweep
catalog.rule: Wick crosses a previously known level by more than tolerance and the close returns inside.

catalog.label: Psychological levels
catalog.rule: Fixed round-number spacing selected by you; these are reference levels, not measured support.

catalog.label: Breakout + retest
catalog.rule: Close above a known high, then a later touch within tolerance and close above it; expires after 8 bars.

catalog.label: Breakdown + retest
catalog.rule: Close below a known low, then a later touch within tolerance and close below it; expires after 8 bars.

catalog.label: False breakout / breakdown
catalog.rule: A closed break returns across the same level within the following 3 bars.

catalog.label: Double top / bottom
catalog.rule: Two similar confirmed pivots, an intervening opposite pivot, then a closed neckline break.

catalog.label: Head and shoulders
catalog.rule: Five alternating confirmed pivots; middle peak above similar shoulders, followed by a close below both neckline lows.

catalog.label: Inverse head and shoulders
catalog.rule: Five alternating confirmed pivots; middle trough below similar shoulders, then a close above both neckline highs.

catalog.label: Trendline break
catalog.rule: Close crosses the extrapolated line of the two latest rising swing lows or falling swing highs.

catalog.label: CHoCH
catalog.rule: First closed swing break against the previously established HH/HL or LH/LL structure.

catalog.label: Bullish engulfing
catalog.rule: Bullish body encloses the prior bearish body after a 3-bar decline.

catalog.label: Bearish engulfing
catalog.rule: Bearish body encloses the prior bullish body after a 3-bar advance.

catalog.label: Hammer
catalog.rule: After a 3-bar decline: lower wick ≥2 bodies, upper wick ≤20% of range, body ≤35%.

catalog.label: Shooting star
catalog.rule: After a 3-bar advance: upper wick ≥2 bodies, lower wick ≤20% of range, body ≤35%.

catalog.label: Doji
catalog.rule: Body is at most 10% of the high-low range; zero-range bars are excluded.

catalog.label: Inside bar
catalog.rule: High strictly below and low strictly above the preceding bar.

catalog.label: Outside bar
catalog.rule: High strictly above and low strictly below the preceding bar.

catalog.label: Marubozu
catalog.rule: Body at least 80% of range and each wick at most 10%.

catalog.label: Morning star
catalog.rule: Prior decline, large bearish body, middle body ≤30% of that body, bullish close above its midpoint. Intraday variant: no gap required.

catalog.label: Evening star
catalog.rule: Prior advance, large bullish body, middle body ≤30% of that body, bearish close below its midpoint. No gap required.

catalog.label: Pin bar / rejection
catalog.rule: One wick ≥60% of range, opposite wick ≤15%, body ≤30%; shape only.

catalog.label: Pullback to support
catalog.rule: In established HH/HL structure, touch the latest confirmed swing low and close back above it.

catalog.label: Pullback to resistance
catalog.rule: In established LH/LL structure, touch the latest confirmed swing high and close back below it.

catalog.label: Bull flag
catalog.rule: 3-bar rise ≥2 prior ATR, then 4 declining consolidation closes with ≤50% retracement; closed break above consolidation.

catalog.label: Bear flag
catalog.rule: 3-bar fall ≥2 prior ATR, then 4 rising consolidation closes with ≤50% retracement; closed break below consolidation.

catalog.label: Ascending triangle
catalog.rule: Three confirmed highs nearly flat and three rising lows; later close above the upper boundary.

catalog.label: Descending triangle
catalog.rule: Three confirmed lows nearly flat and three falling highs; later close below the lower boundary.

catalog.label: Symmetrical triangle
catalog.rule: Three falling highs and three rising lows; close beyond an extrapolated boundary.

catalog.label: Opening range breakout
catalog.rule: First closed break of the selected 5/15/30-minute range. All opening bars required; range must divide the chart timeframe.

catalog.label: Momentum breakout
catalog.rule: Closed swing break with range ≥1.5 prior ATR and body ≥70% of range.

catalog.label: Compression / expansion
catalog.rule: 5-bar span ≤2 prior ATR; subsequent candle range ≥1.5 prior ATR is an expansion.

catalog.label: BOS
catalog.rule: First closed break beyond a confirmed swing in the established structure direction.

catalog.label: Order block candidate
catalog.rule: Last opposite candle within 5 bars before a displacement that closes beyond a known swing; candle range defines the zone.

catalog.label: Fair value gap
catalog.rule: Three consecutive candles: third low above first high, or third high below first low. Zone starts at third-bar confirmation.

catalog.label: Supply / demand candidate
catalog.rule: Last opposite candle within 5 bars preceding a displacement; its full high-low range defines the zone.

catalog.label: Displacement
catalog.rule: Candle range ≥1.5 prior ATR with body ≥70% of range.

catalog.label: Mitigation / retest
catalog.rule: First later overlap of an existing FVG, supply/demand or order-block zone. Zone ends on full traversal.
